title: Effectiveness of Trabeculectomy in Primary Open-Angle Glaucoma with Low Preoperative Intraocular Pressure

license.statement: Dove Medical Press terms incorporating CC BY-NC 4.0 (article <license>); not CC BY, so the record is private

indication: POAG with low preoperative IOP (12 mmHg or less on maximally tolerated medication) and progressing visual field defects
design: retrospective single-surgeon, single-centre, non-randomized observational study; 11 eyes followed for at least 3 years

groups.indication: low-pressure POAG with visual field progression
groups.description: fornix-based trabeculectomy with mitomycin C; 6 of 11 eyes had simultaneous phacoemulsification with IOL (triple surgery)

series.baseline_label: Preoperative IOP, mmHg (Table 2); defined as the mean of the IOPs at the two visits before surgery on glaucoma medication
series.notes: mean ± SD (abstract and Results describe means); follow-up cells also hold the reduction ratio in parentheses, not used; per-visit n not shown, all 11 eyes were followed at least 3 years

exclusions.what: reduction ratio (mean ± SD %) in parentheses in the Table 2 follow-up cells
exclusions.reason: percent change duplicates the absolute IOP series of the same cells

notes: The Table 2 footnote says numbers in parentheses are eye counts, but the parentheses of the IOP cells hold reduction ratios in percent; no per-visit eye count is tabulated.

Inclusion required at least 3 years of follow-up and at least five visual field tests before and after surgery (completeness criteria, not outcome-defined); the Results state that no eye had additional glaucoma surgery within 3 years. The exclusion of 'patients who had undergone filtration glaucoma surgeries' is read as prior filtration surgery.
Phaco combined with trabeculectomy is extracted as trabeculectomy (6 of 11 eyes); the table does not separate the two.
Glaucoma medications were discontinued after surgery and added as needed; medication counts are tabulated in Table 2 (Medications rows); not extracted.
Laser suture lysis was intentionally performed earlier than usual to reach a lower target IOP (Discussion).
Tonometer: Goldmann applanation; time of day not standardized (Methods).
